name: Light-Paws
description: Light-Paws is a seven-tailed kitsune who taught Kaito and Eiko, served as the emperor's advisor at the Imperial Palace in Eiganjo, and became Regent of Kamigawa.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Eiko reconcile over Light-Paws's disbelief, and Eiko offers to bring him home.
timeline.quote: "You can still come home, you know.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws announces Kaito and Eiko will no longer be sparring partners, because Eiko has chosen to study as a kami diplomat.
timeline.quote: Eiko has chosen to study as a kami diplomat.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws tells Kaito there will be no more sparring lessons and that he must choose a path, and Kaito refuses to be a samurai.
timeline.quote: "I don't want to be a samurai,"

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws reveals the emperor told her of Kaito's ideas, and Kaito turns his back on his mentor.
timeline.quote: "What you mean," Kaito replied bitterly, "is that I have no place here."

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws suggests the Futurists are responsible and refuses to listen to Kaito's account.
timeline.quote: "Perhaps the Futurists are responsible for this.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws orders Kaito to his room, and Kaito resolves to leave the palace and search Kamigawa for the man with the metal arm.
timeline.quote: He would search Kamigawa for the man with the metal arm.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws and Eiko arrive and bow to the emperor, who orders the court to prepare against the Uprisers.
timeline.quote: We must prepare our forces at once."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The emperor approves the plan to destroy the compound, and agrees to remain in Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: "I will remain here," she said at last.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer has a vision of the ambush and decides to planeswalk into the compound, with Eiko encouraging her to save Kaito.
timeline.quote: "They were ambushed by Tezzeret and Jin-Gitaxias."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: With her spark destabilizing, the emperor names Light-Paws her proxy to rule Kamigawa with Kyodai's blessing.
timeline.quote: "You will be my proxy, and rule Kamigawa for as long as I am unable."

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws grows a new tail and Kaito and Eiko bow to the new Regent of Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: Kaito and his sister bowed to the new Regent of Kamigawa.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Emperor appoints Light-Paws to guide Kamigawa in her absence.
timeline.quote: the Emperor appointed the wise Light-Paws to guide Kamigawa in her absence.

citation.text: Regent's Authority (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws counsels remembering the dead.
timeline.quote: Mourn them, envy them, but above all, remember them.

citation.text: Release to Memory (Neon Dynasty Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias unlocks the secret of compleating planeswalkers and uses it on Tamiyo; the Emperor stabilizes her spark and names Light-Paws regent.
timeline.quote: eventually unlocking the secret to compleating planeswalkers before implementing it on his first subject, Tamiyo .

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor returns and appoints Light-Paws acting Regent of Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: the two agreed to appoint Light-Paws acting Regent of Kamigawa.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer briefly returns to Kamigawa, meets Kaito, and reconnects with Kyodai thanks to the Reality Chip; she and Kyodai appoint Light-Paws acting Regent.
timeline.quote: she and the spirit agreed to appoint Light-Paws acting Regent of Kamigawa.

citation.text: "The Wanderer", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer loses her spark in the Desparkening and the Emperor travels the plane while Light-Paws rules.
timeline.quote: the Wanderer lost her spark in the Desparkening .

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "After the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer loses her spark in the Great Desparkening and uses the chance to travel her home plane while Light-Paws rules as regent.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer lost her spark in the Great Desparkening

citation.text: "The Wanderer", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Emperor ends the Asari Uprisers' rebellion with Kaito and appoints Light-Paws as Regent before being ripped away.
timeline.quote: she appointed Light-Paws as Regent of the plane
